profile.headline: Experienced software engineer
profile.summary:
Versatile software engineer with experience developing web applications from conception to market and support. Real-world understanding of deployment engineering and systems support. Experience with architecture and scalability.

Specialties: XHTML, CSS, JavaScript, Unix/Linux, Ruby on Rails, Chef, Capistrano

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Red Nova Labs merged with a few other companies to become Storable.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed, built, integrated, launched, and maintained front-end boarding pass advertisement software with five major airline partners.
•	Engineered system architecture and wrote back-end software providing a web-service delivered on partner’s schedule.
•	Managed in-house software tools supporting business and engineering coworkers.
•	Created deployment software utilizing infrastructure automation and moved systems to the cloud, resulting in 85% cost savings and zero-downtime deployment capability.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Improved process by utilizing test-driven development and scripted builds for higher efficiency and quality.
•	Constructed first iteration of concept product in Java using Spring and Hibernate.
